name: Yummy Pepper House
reviews: 菜品非常好吃，色香味俱全，服务也非常周到热心，餐厅大堂明亮赞😋

Absolutely authentic Sichuan food! 天府飘香 has amazing flavors, generous portions, and that real spicy “mala” taste. The dishes were fresh, rich in flavor, and perfectly cooked. The staff were friendly and service was fast even when busy.

Highly recommend the boiled fish, spicy chicken, and mapo tofu if you love traditional Sichuan cuisine. One of the best Chinese restaurants I’ve had in Sydney. Will definitely come back again!
环境很好，菜品味道也不错，服务员态度友好。
Awesome taste. I've been coming here for the past six months. Love the food.
The food was absolutely delicious and full of flavor. The service was friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome.
